brand.purpose: Opt-in Obviously product name inside the primary navigation lockup only.

display.purpose: Opt-in Obviously display face for rare product intros and report mastheads only.

headline.purpose: Primary screen and major region headings.

micro.purpose: Short status badges and dense chart labels only.

shadows.name: state-lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered draggable or explicitly raised work items.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, switch, and button feedback.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Selection, progressive disclosure, and local state change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a focused region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .625rem .875rem; border: 0; border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--primary, #1ee4bc); color: var(--primary-foreground, #0a0a0a); font: 500 .875rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 46%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action that stays subordinate to the primary decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .625rem .875rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--secondary, #262626); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #fafafa); font: 500 .875rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent, #303030); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 46%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A stable, readable field for operational data entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .5rem; color: var(--foreground, #fafafa); font: 500 .875rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .625rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, rgba(255,255,255,.15)); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--card, #171717); color: var(--card-foreground, #fafafa); font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary, #1ee4bc); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state with icon or text redundancy.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; min-height: 1.75rem; padding: .25rem .625rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 40%, transparent); border-radius: .5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 10%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #fafafa); font: 500 .75rem/1.35 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status > span { color: var(--primary, #1ee4bc); font-size: .625rem; }

components.name: Work Surface
components.description: A quiet task grouping, not a decorative card.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,.1)); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--card, #171717); color: var(--card-foreground, #fafafa); } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0; font: 500 1.1875rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface p { max-width: 65ch; margin: .5rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a3a3a3); font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1ee4bc) 55%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: A focused place where complex activity becomes clear, actionable state. The system is precise, confident, and alive, with familiar SaaS dashboard ergonomics and product-specific composition.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite and paper neutrals with turquoise used as a scarce signal.
Fixed readable product typography with predictable metrics.
Tonal layering at rest and lift only for active state.
Dense information grouped by task rather than card reflex.
Responsive composition at 320, 390, 768, and 1440 CSS pixels.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Turquoise must stay below roughly ten percent of a screen. If the whole interface glows, nothing is a signal.

rules.name: The Metric Gate
rules.body: Reject a UI font if ordinary controls require vertical offsets or metric overrides.

rules.name: The Compact Number Rule
rules.body: Dense number displays use compact notation with at most three significant digits; decision-relevant exact values stay available in details.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces are tonal; only active or temporary layers lift.

rules.name: The State-change Grammar
rules.body: Numbers roll or crossfade, short labels crossfade, local panels slide with direction, and operational text never scrambles.

dos: Do make important state obvious before adding decoration.
Do use real 400/500 weights for everyday product UI; keep Brand and Display restricted.
Do change composition for mobile around the immediate task.
donts: Don't produce generic shadcn dashboard output or card grids without hierarchy.
Don't use unbounded neon, glow, gradient, glass, or motion as product meaning; the bounded product lockup is the exception.
Don't use Obviously as universal product text or accept baseline hacks.
Don't compress desktop workflows into mobile.
